comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Packages and the registry
themes.text: `nvs` installs and locks the packages your program uses, and the registry builds every package from its source code. `nvs pkg audit` lists the known security problems in your packages, and the version that fixes each one.

themes.title: Passkeys and Web Push
themes.text: `Core\Passkey` lets a user sign in with a passkey. `Core\WebPush` sends a notification to a browser.
